name: enemy
entries: A pack of moss-covered wolves that share one mind and retreat if their oldest member is separated from the group.
A chicken-demon the size of a horse, fiercely territorial and able to mimic a frightened child's voice.
Three animated suits of armor arguing over which of them is the original knight.
A bridge troll who demands memories instead of money and grows stronger when offered sad ones.
A bandit captain who robs only corrupt travelers but has mistakenly judged the party by a forged document.
A translucent cave bear filled with floating stars; bright light makes it solid and vulnerable.
A colony of coin-sized mimics moving together as a glittering carpet around one genuine treasure.
An exhausted necromancer pursued by the very skeletons they raised, all of whom now demand unpaid wages.
A headless duelist who challenges the strongest-looking traveler and politely returns stolen equipment after a fair defeat.
A swamp witch whose hut walks on reed-thin legs while animated roots defend it from intruders.
A mirror knight who copies the last attack used against them but cannot repeat the same response twice.
A choir of drowned spirits whose song drains courage; completing their unfinished verse calms them.
A mercenary squad equipped to counter the party's most obvious tactics, hired by an unknown observer.
A giant snail carrying a ruined watchtower on its shell and defending the tiny community living inside.
A court vampire with three conflicting personalities, each honoring different promises and recognizing different enemies.
A living wildfire that hunts anyone carrying an ember stolen from its sacred forest.
A blind basilisk guided by clever lizards that steal reflective objects before an ambush.
A fungal giant releasing spores that create illusory copies whenever it takes a heavy hit.
A tax collector protected by enchanted paperwork, two stone bailiffs, and the full authority of an absurd law.
A fallen hero wielding a famous relic that is slowly controlling their actions.
A burrowing bone serpent whose exposed spine forms a moving line of cover across the battlefield.
An alchemist's escaped sludge that absorbs potions and gains a different temporary power from each one.
A silent hunting party from a subterranean race convinced that surface voices awaken an ancient predator.
A young dragon running a protection racket because its hoard was repossessed by a banking guild.
A rune-powered siege automaton still following orders from a war that ended two centuries ago.
An angelic judge whose radiant servants enforce a definition of justice no mortal can satisfy.
A rival adventuring party with the same objective, better publicity, and one member secretly willing to cooperate.
A sentient blizzard circling a frozen heart; fire weakens its body but strengthens its rage.
A royal assassin who openly announces each attack because an oath forbids striking the unprepared.
A forgotten god wearing a harmless scarecrow body, weak for now but empowered whenever anyone says its true name.
